name: profile-capture-isolation
goal: Independent runtime observation producers and successive flushes retain distinct immutable capture chunks with no overwritten evidence.

evidence: The one-pass API introduced at5790bba3 keys capture paths by unit, callable, workload and completion only. Independent producers or repeated flushes share that key and can overwrite earlier observation bytes. Reproduce before connecting standard workers.

The standard profiler suite covers separate workloads and clearing one flush, but not multiple producers or successive chunks for the same workload. Extend that suite with distinct producer instances and repeated flushes, asserting unique paths and intact per-chunk samples.
